name: Project Dualis
source:
A story of two sisters, Yuki and Yumi, who are linked together more closely than what it would first seem. Haru, a first year student in Kakunoshima high, joins the literary club and meets the shy and reclusive Yuki, but soon finds himself on a collision course with her overprotective sister...

Project Dualis is a visual novel on love and the meaning of one's self.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22798]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
這是尤紀與尤美兩姊妹的故事。這對姊妹的感情比表面上還要緊密。卡庫諾希馬高中的一年級學生哈魯加入了文學社，認識了害羞而離群索居的尤紀，卻很快發現自己與她那保護欲過強的姊姊發生了衝突……

《雙生計畫》是一部探討愛情與自我意義的視覺小說。

（摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22798]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]）
